topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Another day, another demand. My neighbor has decided that a fence is the solution to a problem I didn’t even know we had. As if the quiet of my mornings and the peace of my garden weren’t enough, now there’s a new project disrupting the calm. Of course, they’ll pick the weekend, when any semblance of rest is drowned out by the relentless bang of hammers and the whine of drills. I’m supposed to smile and say it’s fine, that it’s just progress, but it feels more like an invasion. Privacy, they say? Fine. See how you like walls around you. Maybe it’ll teach us all a lesson about just how much space we really need.
